pinNoRecoveryNotice: GymVito has no account server and cannot reset or recover this PIN. Keep it somewhere safe.

privacyNoAutomaticUpload: GymVito does not automatically upload operational data.
privacyExportsUserControlled: Only actions you start can share or save files through a provider you choose.
privacyDeviceRisk: A rooted or fully compromised device can weaken local protection.
backupPhaseNotice: After setup, open More → Backup and recovery to create your first encrypted backup. Keep its passphrase separately; GymVito cannot recover it.

noActivePlans: Create or activate a plan before enrolling this member.

photoFailed: The photo could not be processed. Choose another image.
memberCodeGenerated: A unique member code will be generated when you save.
noteAppendHint: A new note is appended; previous notes are preserved.
duplicateWarningMessage: A matching phone, email, or member code exists. Review it before saving. Records are never merged automatically.
invoiceDueDateHint: Used for local due and overdue tracking.
invoiceCreatedWithMembershipNotice: Confirming creates the membership and its invoice together. Payment can be recorded now or later.
recordPaymentNowHint: Optional. The membership, invoice, and recorded payment are saved together.
phase4ReadyMessage: Invoices, partial payments, dues, immutable corrections, and bilingual PDF receipts stay on this device.
localFinancialLedger: Local invoices, recorded payments, dues, and receipts
recordedPaymentsOnly: Recorded locally • No online processing or bank settlement
paymentsLoadFailed: The local financial ledger could not be loaded.
noPaymentsRecorded: No payments have been recorded yet.
paymentAmountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
paymentExceedsOutstanding: The amount cannot exceed the outstanding balance.
recordedPaymentNotice: This action records the payment in GymVito's local ledger. It does not process or settle money.
paymentSaveFailed: The payment could not be recorded. Nothing partial was saved.
invoiceLoadFailed: This invoice could not be loaded.
printDialogOpened: The system print dialog was opened. Cancelling it does not change the payment record.
shareDialogOpened: The system share dialog was opened. Cancelling it does not change the payment record.
receiptOpenedForSharing: The receipt PDF was opened. Use the viewer's Share action to send it.
receiptSavedForSharing: The receipt PDF was saved in the selected folder. Open it there to share it.
sharingUnavailable: Sharing is unavailable on this device. The payment remains recorded.
receiptActionFailed: The receipt action could not be completed. The payment remains recorded.
receiptPdfCreationFailed: The receipt PDF could not be created. The payment remains recorded.
receiptPrintFailed: The system print dialog could not be opened. The payment remains recorded.
receiptShareFailed: The system share sheet could not be opened. The payment remains recorded.
receiptShareFailedWithCode: The PDF could not be shared, opened, or saved. The payment remains recorded. Error: {{code}}
financialHistoryImmutable: Finalized invoices and payments cannot be deleted. Owner corrections append a traceable ledger event.
correctionAppendsEvent: This keeps the original payment and appends a traceable reversal. It cannot be undone by deletion.
paymentCorrectionSaved: The correction was appended to the ledger.
paymentCorrectionFailed: The correction could not be recorded. The ledger was not changed.
billingSettingsHistoryNotice: Prefix and label changes apply only to future numbers and payments. Historical invoices and receipts keep their saved values.
numberPrefixHint: Use 1–8 uppercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. Existing numbers never change.
billingSettingsSaved: Billing settings saved for future records.
billingSettingsLoadFailed: Billing settings could not be loaded.
billingSettingsSaveFailed: Billing settings could not be saved.
numberPrefixInvalid: Use 1–8 letters, numbers, or hyphens for each prefix.
backupCenterSubtitle: Protect this device's complete local business record.
backupNativeBuildRequired: Encrypted backup and restore require a GymVito development or release build. Expo Go remains synthetic-data only.
createBackupCardBody: Encrypt the complete database with a passphrase, verify it, then choose a system document destination.
restoreBackupCardBody: Validate and preview a .gymvito file before atomically replacing this device's data.
backupLocalOnlyNotice: GymVito does not upload backups. A third-party document provider is used only when you explicitly choose it in the system picker.
backupHistoryLoadFailed: Backup history could not be loaded. Your business records are unchanged.
noBackupHistory: No backup or restore attempt has been recorded on this device.
deleteAllCardBody: This resets GymVito on this device. A backup and owner verification are strongly recommended.
backupPassphraseWarning: GymVito cannot recover this passphrase. Without it, the backup cannot be restored.
backupPassphraseGuidance: Use at least 12 characters including a letter and a number. Do not reuse the owner PIN.
backupPassphraseMismatch: The two backup passphrases do not match.
backupPassphraseInvalid: The passphrase is wrong, too weak, or the selected file is damaged.
backupOwnerPinIncorrect: Owner verification failed. Check the PIN and try again.
backupLowStorage: There is not enough free storage to complete and verify this action safely.
backupCreateFailed: The backup was not saved. The previous successful-backup status was not changed.
restoreReplacesNotice: Restore replaces all current local data only after validation, a safety copy, migration, and reconciliation succeed.
restoreConfirmation: I understand this verified backup will replace all current local records.
restoreValidationFailed: This backup could not be validated. Current data was not changed.
restoreFailedPreserved: Restore did not complete. GymVito retained the prior local database.
restoreNewerVersion: This backup was created by a newer GymVito version. Update the app before restoring it.
restoreWrongFile: Choose a valid .gymvito backup created by GymVito.
deleteAllPermanentNotice: This permanently removes the database and device encryption key. GymVito has no server copy and cannot undo it.
deleteBackupAcknowledgement: I saved a verified backup, or I choose to continue without one.
deleteAllFailed: Local data could not be deleted completely. Restart GymVito and try again.
homeBackupNeeded: Backup needed — local data is at risk
homeNoVerifiedBackup: No verified backup has been saved yet.
recoveryRestoreSubtitle: Use a verified encrypted backup when this is a new device or the local database cannot open.
recoveryRestoreNotice: Only the selected backup passphrase can unlock this file. A successful restore replaces any inaccessible or incomplete local database.
recoveryConfirmation: I recognize this gym and want to make this verified backup the active local database.
reportsSubtitle: Local business summaries and portable records
reportLoadFailed: The report could not be loaded.
exportPrivacyWarning: Exports contain personal and financial data. Save or share them only to a trusted destination. GymVito deletes its temporary cache copy after the share sheet closes.
exportReady: The export was handed to your selected app.
exportUnavailable: Sharing is unavailable on this device.
exportFailed: The export could not be created.
invalidDateRange: Enter valid ISO dates with the start on or before the end.
uninstallDataLossWarning: Uninstalling GymVito, clearing app storage, losing this device, or resetting it can permanently erase every record not included in a verified encrypted backup.
privacyStoredFields: Gym identity, member contact and profile details, membership history, invoices, recorded payments, and settings are stored on this device.
privacyEncryptedDevice: Production builds encrypt the local database with a device key. A rooted, compromised, or unlocked device can still weaken that protection.
privacyNoAutomaticUploadDetailed: GymVito has no operational backend and does not automatically upload gym, member, or financial data. It includes no advertising, tracking, or remote analytics SDK.
privacyExternalDestinations: Exports, receipts, and backups leave GymVito only after you start an action and choose a system share or document destination. That destination has its own privacy practices.
privacyOwnerResponsibility: The gym owner is responsible for device access, lawful record handling, trusted export destinations, and keeping backup passphrases separately and securely.
helpBackupCreate: Create an encrypted backup after setup and after important changes. Confirm it appears in the destination you selected.
helpBackupPassphrase: GymVito cannot recover a forgotten owner PIN or backup passphrase. Keep the backup and its passphrase in separate secure places.
helpBackupRestore: Restore validates the file and shows a preview before replacement. Existing data is replaced only after owner authentication and explicit confirmation.
helpStatusActive: Active means the device-local date falls within the inclusive membership start and end dates.
helpStatusUpcoming: Upcoming means a finalized membership starts after the current device-local date.
helpStatusExpired: Expired means the latest finalized membership ended before the current device-local date.
helpStatusDue: Due and overdue amounts come from finalized invoices minus recorded payments and corrections. They do not confirm bank settlement.
helpWorkflowMember: Add a member, open the profile, then enroll or renew using an active plan. Finalized plan terms remain in history.
helpWorkflowPayment: Open an outstanding invoice to record a partial or full payment, then create a localized receipt.
helpWorkflowReports: Use Reports for reconciled summaries. Data export requires the owner PIN and may contain private and financial information.
helpPermissionsScoped: GymVito uses system pickers and share sheets for files. Grant access only when you initiate the related action.
helpPermissionsFallback: If a permission or destination is unavailable, cancel the action and keep using local records; a failed export or backup does not delete saved data.
localFirstSummary: Designed for one-device gym operations in English and Hindi, using the device time zone and no GymVito cloud account or synchronization.
